```yaml
name: Claude Auto-Review

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    types:
      - opened

jobs:
  claude-auto-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Add Reown tone of voice extract
        run: |
          echo "## Tone of Voice Compliance" > reown-tone-of-voice-extract.md
          echo "" >> reown-tone-of-voice-extract.md
          echo "Reown has a specific tone of voice that should be followed in all our documentation." >> reown-tone-of-voice-extract.md
          echo "This document outlines the guidelines for maintaining the correct tone of voice in our documentation." >> reown-tone-of-voice-extract.md

      - name: Configure project context
        run: |
          echo "## Project Context" > project_context.md
          echo "" >> project_context.md
          echo "The Mintlify docs are designed to provide comprehensive information about the Mintlify platform." >> project_context.md
          echo "Our content structure follows a logical flow, starting from basic concepts and moving to advanced topics." >> project_context.md
          echo "We have a deep understanding of Web3 and multichain technologies, which informs our approach to documenting these subjects." >> project_context.md
          echo "When reviewing PRs, please ensure that the content adheres to the following focus areas:" >> project_context.md
          echo "- Clarity and accuracy of technical information" >> project_context.md
          echo "- Consistency in terminology and style" >> project_context.md
          echo "- Relevance and usefulness of the content for our audience" >> project_context.md

      - name: Run Claude auto-review
        uses: WalletConnect/actions/claude/auto-review@master
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          project_context: project_context.md
          review_command: "@claude review"
          tone_of_voice: reown-tone-of-voice-extract.md
```
